Callback bot

This panel is sandboxed (no session, no callback token). Rotate the project callback token on the form above. JSON deliveries include callback_token and callback_url for your relay.

  • Permissions: tasks:read, tasks:write, comments:write
  • Inbound verbs (when inbound webhooks are enabled): complete, set_field, comment
  • Fields: callback-bot.review_by (date), callback-bot.notes (markdown)
curl -sS -X POST "$CALLBACK_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CALLBACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"comment","task_id":42,"comment":"Noted by callback-bot"}'
